title: 第12章 奇妙的字画
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
楼上并未有回应，但王老知道郁神医一定能听到他所说的话，毕竟这人的神通，现在他已经切身的体会到了。

    王景焕虽然不清楚他爷爷到底和那个郁神医谈了些什么，但想必事情已经是已经达成一致了。

    这就不得说老爷子这么多孙子孙女，为什么会单单宠爱他了，论猜测老爷子的心理，他王景焕要认第二，可没人敢认第一。

    他走上前去扶过老爷子，对郁嘉庆笑着说道：“今日我们也算是一见如故，不如明天安排一个饭局庆祝一番，嘉庆哥，你意下如何？”

    郁嘉庆当然求之不得，他也想和这样的商业精英好好交流交流，从他们口中了解一些情况。

    更别提王老还是他的偶像了，这能和偶像接近的机会，他可不会错过。

    “当然可以，那你明天定好位置后发消息给我。”

    郁嘉庆知道两人要离开，立即将郁景已经准备好的茶叶递给王景焕。

    王景焕拿着茶叶笑得合不拢嘴。

    然而才进客梯，便听到了他爷爷说：“饭局的事情你做的很好，这是那个小兄弟给你的茶叶吧？”

    听到爷爷这话，王景焕瞬间将自己的茶叶紧紧的捂了起来。

    “爷爷，这个是嘉庆哥送给我的。”

    王老爷横了他一眼，“你年纪轻，也不爱喝茶，不如将这茶叶给我吧。”

    “而且你和郁嘉庆两人关系好，以后也不用担心没茶喝。”

    王景焕有些不知道说什么，他爷爷怎么跟个土匪似的，当然这话只能在心里吐槽一下。

    “爷爷，你现在和郁神医不是也关系匪浅吗？要一点茶叶也不过分吧。”他嘟囔道。

    “那怎么能一样？”让他腆着一张老脸去找人家讨茶叶，他不要面子的吗？

    即使王景焕在不情愿，这几两茶叶还是到了王老爷子手里。

    而这边，王家爷孙出门后，郁凡也没有了出去的打算了。

    他原本是想多了解一下当今社会的情况，找个契机给儿子寻找一个进入商界的引路人，而如今引路人已经有了，他自然也没有了出去的必要。

    郁颜叽叽喳喳的跟自家爸爸说着有关王景焕的事情。

    郁嘉庆有些疑惑自己女儿的兴奋，不由得想歪了点。

    “你很喜欢王景焕？”

    郁颜脸一红，连忙解释：“我哪里是喜欢他，我只是觉得像他这样能年纪轻轻便打出自己的一番天地的人不容易。”
content_en:
There was no response from upstairs, but Mr. Wang knew that Doctor Yu would definitely be able to hear what he said. After all, he had now personally experienced this man's magical power.

Although Wang Jinghuan didn't know exactly what his grandfather had talked about with the Yu Shen doctor, he must have reached an agreement.

This doesn't mean why the old man only dotes on him when he has so many grandchildren. When it comes to guessing the old man's psychology, Wang Jinghuan wants to take him second, but no one dares to take him first.

He stepped forward to help the old man, smiled at Yu Jiaqing and said, "We feel like old friends at first sight today. Why don't we arrange a dinner to celebrate tomorrow. Brother Jiaqing, what do you think?"

Of course Yu Jiaqing couldn't ask for it. He also wanted to communicate with such business elites and learn something about the situation from their mouths.

Not to mention that Mr. Wang is still his idol. He will not miss this opportunity to get close to his idol.

"Of course. Then you can send me a message after you have decided on the location tomorrow."

Yu Jiaqing knew that the two were leaving, and immediately handed the tea that Yu Jing had prepared to Wang Jinghuan.

Wang Jinghuan held the tea and smiled from ear to ear.

However, just after entering the passenger elevator, he heard his grandfather say: "You did a good job at the dinner. Is this the tea that the little brother gave you?"

After hearing his grandfather's words, Wang Jinghuan immediately covered his tea leaves tightly.

"Grandpa, Brother Jiaqing gave this to me."

Mr. Wang gave him a sideways glance, "You are young and don't like tea, so why not give me this tea."

"Besides, you and Yu Jiaqing have a good relationship, so you don't have to worry about running out of tea in the future."

Wang Jinghuan didn't know what to say. Why did his grandfather act like a bandit? Of course, he could only complain about this in his heart.

"Grandpa, don't you have a close relationship with Doctor Yu now? It's not too much to ask for some tea." He muttered.

"How can it be the same?" Asking him to go to others to ask for tea with a shy old face, doesn't he want to lose face?

Even though Wang Jinghuan was reluctant, these few taels of tea were still in the hands of Mr. Wang.

And here, after the Wang family's grandson went out, Yu Fan had no plans to go out.

He originally wanted to learn more about today's society and find an opportunity to find a guide for his son to enter the business world. But now that he has a guide, he naturally has no need to go out.

Yu Yan chattered to her father about Wang Jinghuan.

Yu Jiaqing was a little confused about his daughter's excitement, and couldn't help but think a little wrong.

"You like Wang Jinghuan very much?"

Yu Yan blushed and quickly explained: "I don't like him, I just think it's not easy for someone like him to make a name for himself at such a young age."
